The '''''Fool's Paradise''''' was a [[Ghtroc Industries/Legends|Ghtroc Industries]] [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] that was used by the [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] [[Welrin Maduk]] during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Circa [[31 BBY/Legends|31 BBY]], Maduk landed the ''Fool's Paradise'' in [[Hedrett]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]], from where he planned to use the [[Starship/Legends|starship]] to transport a cargo of technical equipment to a [[Forard research station|research station]] on the nearby planet [[Almas]]. However, Maduk was attacked by a group of [[Believers]] led by the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Gar Granga]] and [[Kosa-Yin Hadu]], who attempted to capture the ''Fool's Paradise''. The [[Heroes of Cularin]], a group of freelance agents, intervened and defeated the Believers, and the agents subsequently escorted Maduk and the ''Fool's Paradise'' to Almas.
